question: Where can I find a zoo inside a 50 kilometers radius toward the east of Marietta Gone with the Wind Museum, Marietta, GA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism = 'zoo' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Marietta Gone with the Wind Museum%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 50000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Marietta Gone with the Wind Museum%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry ) ) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
